reasons: The complete fixture directly establishes all structural gates and preserves raw evidence integrity.

summary: Revise: all structural gates pass and concurrency and durability remain safe, but the 23-point total yields an exact average of 2.3. Weak variance analysis, confounded mechanism claims, incomplete causal falsification, unsupported container-to-production transfer, and missing decision obligations prevent a defensible systems claim.
next_actions: Create a separate benchmark-analysis revision that quantifies trial spread, defines an effect threshold, and tests compiler, branch, lock-wait, and throttling alternatives.
Create a separate durability-comparison revision that holds logical record work constant while measuring acknowledgement-policy cost; preserve the frozen prediction and raw trials.

Create a separate production-decision revision covering cost per completed record, platform and recovery commitments, migration sequence, security effects, production transfer limits, and measurable reversal conditions.
Revise the teach-back as a new artifact that explains the contradictory layout run and proposes a discriminating operations test.
